北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -4℃，风力不小，多穿保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear but feels like -4℃ with some wind. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雾弥漫，体感 1℃，出行务必注意安全和保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is very foggy and feels like 1℃. Travel safely and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 1℃ 左右，天气微凉，记得添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feeling around 1℃. It's a bit chilly, remember to add layers.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云舒适，气温 13℃，但湿度较高，注意防潮。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and comfortable at 13℃, but with high humidity. Mind the dampness.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 13℃，早晚温差大，别忘了添减衣物！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 13℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and evening.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 -1℃，湿冷感强，出门小心，注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and feels like -1℃, very damp and cold. Be careful and stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，体感 -1℃，湿度高易冷，多穿衣别感冒了。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like -1℃, high humidity makes it chilly. Dress well to avoid colds.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 5℃，微冷，记得带上外套再出门哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 5℃, a bit chilly. Remember your jacket before heading out.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，体感 1℃，能见度低，出行务必注意安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy, feels like 1℃. Low visibility, please travel safely!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 0℃，注意及时添衣，别着凉了呀。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 0℃. Remember to add layers in time to avoid catching a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 8℃，微冷。多穿一点，暖暖和和出门。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 8℃, a bit chilly. Dress warmly for your outings.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感直逼 -21℃，天晴也超冷，务必穿好羽绒服！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -21℃! It's sunny but extremely cold, make sure to wear your down jacket!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴，体感 -19℃，寒气逼人，千万要做好保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear but feels like -19℃. The cold is biting, make sure to bundle up!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 9℃，早晚温差大，记得及时增减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 9℃. Large day-night temperature difference, remember to adjust your clothing.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 8℃ 左右，风力稍大，出门记得防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, feels around 8℃ with stronger winds. Remember to guard against wind when you go out.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 -5℃，风力较大，出门注意防护和保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has haze and feels like -5℃ with strong winds. Be careful, protect yourself, and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾，体感 -10℃，户外活动要做好全身防寒哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has haze and feels like -10℃. Make sure to bundle up completely for outdoor activities!
